question: In which year was an approach and program named Joint Forest Management (JFM) launched in the context of National Forest Policy?
solution:
The correct answer is__** 1988.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Joint Forest Management **(JFM) is a collaborative effort between the **forest department **and **local communities** to manage and protect forest resources.
 
• JFM was launched in** 1988** in the context of the **National Forest Policy of India**, which aimed to involve local communities in forest conservation and management.
 
• The program has been successful in **improving forest cover **and **reducing deforestation** in several parts of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **National Forest Policy, 1952, **was implemented by the Indian government after the country gained its** independence in 1947.**
 
• It categorized wooded regions into four categories: **village forests, protected forests, national forests, **and common trees between people's dwelling places.
 
• The primary goal of the National Forest Policy of** 1988** is to maintain** ecological balance,** including atmospheric equilibrium, and environmental stability, all of which are essential for the survival of all living things, including** humans, animals, and plants.**
